title: Every request type has a route
story: As an HR admin, I want each request type to have a default approval route so that no request is ever stuck without an approver.
acceptance: Given a new request type is registered, when it has no company policy, then the default policy is used and the request still gets a route (YX-WF-01).
Given two policies match a request, when it is submitted, then the policy with the higher priority wins and its name is saved on the request (YX-WF-03).
Given a request was submitted, when HR edits the policy later, then the open request keeps its saved steps and approvers (YX-WF-02).
Given a request is submitted, when I open it, then I see the matched policy and the approvers for each step.

title: System finds the right approver
story: As an employee, I want my request to go to the right person automatically so that I do not have to chase anyone.
acceptance: Given I am also the approver at a step, when my request is submitted, then I am removed from that step and the fallback approver is used if the step becomes empty (YX-WF-04).
Given an approver leaves the company or becomes inactive, when this happens, then their open tasks move to the new approver or fallback and the timeline shows the move (YX-WF-06).
Given a step uses 'reporting manager' or 'HR admin of location', when the request is submitted, then the approver is found from the employee's current data.

title: Approver approves, rejects or sends back
story: As a manager, I want to approve, reject or send back a request with a reason so that the employee knows what to do next.
acceptance: Given I reject or send back a request, when I submit, then a reason is required (YX-WF-08).
Given the request type allows changes, when I approve with changes, then I must give a reason for each change (YX-WF-08).
Given any action is taken, when anyone opens the request, then the timeline shows who acted, on behalf of whom, the channel, the reason and the changes (YX-WF-12).

Given a request was sent back, when the employee resubmits with no change to condition fields, then it resumes at the step that sent it back; if condition fields changed, it restarts at step 1 with a new snapshot (YX-WF-15).

title: Approval effects run exactly once
story: As an HR admin, I want the result of an approval (for example a leave ledger entry) to happen exactly once so that balances are never doubled or lost.
acceptance: Given the final approval is given, when the effect is a ledger posting, then it is written in the same transaction as the decision (YX-WF-10).
Given an effect runs as a background job, when the job is retried, then the effect is applied only once (YX-WF-10).
Given the effect fails, when the job gives up, then HR sees the failed request with the error and can retry it.

title: Manager delegates approvals while away
story: As a manager, I want to name a delegate while I am on leave so that my team's requests are not delayed.
acceptance: Given I set a delegate for some dates, when a request comes to me in that time, then my delegate can act on my behalf and the timeline says so (YX-WF-07).
Given my delegate has also delegated, when a request arrives, then it does not pass on to a second delegate (YX-WF-07).
Given my delegate cannot see some fields of the employee, when they open the request, then those fields stay hidden (YX-WF-07).

title: Maker and checker are different people
story: As a payroll admin, I want money-moving requests to need a second person so that one person cannot approve their own work.
acceptance: Given a request type is marked maker ≠ checker (payroll run, bank file, statutory payment), when the maker tries to approve it, then the action is blocked (YX-WF-05).
Given the company has only one admin user, when the single-user exception is on, then the approval is allowed and recorded as an exception (YX-WF-05).
Given the same person is approver at two steps, when duplicate auto-approval is on, then it is never applied to the checker step (YX-WF-17).

title: My approvals queue with the same counts everywhere
story: As a manager, I want one list of things waiting for me so that I can clear them quickly.
acceptance: Given I have pending tasks, when I open home, the approvals queue, mobile or a dashboard, then the pending count is the same everywhere (YX-WF-14).
Given I open the queue, when I filter by type or age, then the list and its count update together (YX-WF-14).
Given I select many leave requests, when I approve them in bulk, then each one is approved and logged separately (YX-WF-12).

title: HR edits approval policies safely
story: As an HR admin, I want to edit approval routes and test them before saving so that I do not break approvals.
acceptance: Given I do not have workflow.policy.manage (and the owner permission for sensitive types), when I open the editor, then I cannot save (YX-WF-16).
Given I changed a policy, when I press save, then I must run Simulate first (YX-WF-16).
Given I save, when it succeeds, then a new policy version is created and the change is audited (YX-WF-16, YX-WF-02).

title: HR raises a request on behalf of an employee
story: As an HR admin, I want to raise a leave or attendance request for a worker without a phone so that their time is recorded correctly.
acceptance: Given I hold request.raise_on_behalf, when the request type is enabled for my role, then I can raise it for the employee (YX-WF-18).
Given I raise it, when policies run, then they use the subject employee's data and the timeline says 'raised by X on behalf of Y' (YX-WF-18).
Given the request is raised, when it is saved, then the employee is notified and neither I nor the employee can approve it (YX-WF-18, YX-WF-04).

title: Request access from a permission-denied page
story: As an employee, I want to ask for access when I see 'permission denied' so that the right admin can give it to me.
acceptance: Given I see the permission-denied state, when I press Request access, then I must give a reason (YX-WF-19).
Given I submit, when it routes, then it goes to the HR admin in scope of the record owner, then System Admin as fallback (YX-WF-19).
Given the area is restricted (for example POSH), when I am denied, then the Request access button is not shown (YX-WF-19).

title: Notifications are sent once and never lost
story: As an employee, I want to get each notification exactly once so that I trust the messages.
acceptance: Given a change is rolled back, when the transaction ends, then no notification is sent (YX-NTF-01).
Given a change is committed, when the server restarts before sending, then the notification is still sent (YX-NTF-01).
Given a retry happens, when the same event, person and channel are sent again, then the person gets it only once (YX-NTF-02).
Given a send fails, when retries run out, then the attempt is logged with status and provider id (YX-NTF-10).

title: In-app inbox and push notifications
story: As an employee, I want an inbox in the app and push messages on my phone so that I see what needs my attention.
acceptance: Given 10 leave requests arrive for the same group in a short window, when I open the inbox, then I see one grouped item with a count (YX-NTF-09).
Given the grouped count, when I open the approvals queue, then the numbers match (YX-NTF-09, YX-WF-14).
Given I lost access to the subject record before sending, when the notification is sent, then I get nothing (YX-NTF-03).

title: Email channel with editable templates
story: As an HR admin, I want to edit email and in-app wording with a preview so that messages sound like our company.
acceptance: Given I edit a template, when I insert a variable, then only variables marked external-safe can be used in email (YX-NTF-04).
Given an employee prefers Tamil, when an email is sent, then it is in Tamil with Indian number and date formats; missing language falls back to company default, then English (YX-NTF-08).
Given I press test send, when it goes, then I get the preview email; reset to default restores the original wording.

title: Approve from an email or WhatsApp link
story: As a manager, I want to approve a simple request with one tap from a message so that I do not need to open the app.
acceptance: Given a low-risk request type, when the approval message is sent, then it carries a signed single-use link that expires (default 72 h) (YX-WF-13).
Given I tap the link, when my permission has changed since the message, then the action is refused (YX-WF-13).
Given the request type is high risk, when the message is sent, then it has no approve link, only a link to open the app (YX-WF-13).

title: WhatsApp channel with approved templates and opt-in
story: As an HR admin, I want to connect our WhatsApp business number so that workers get key updates where they read them.
acceptance: Given an employee has no active WhatsApp opt-in, when a WhatsApp message is due, then it goes by in-app, push or email instead and the fallback is logged (YX-NTF-14).
Given a business-initiated message, when no approved template exists, then it falls back to another channel and logs why (YX-NTF-07).
Given a number blocks us, when the block is reported, then we stop using that number until it changes (YX-NTF-11).
Given an OTP over WhatsApp, when it is sent, then it ignores quiet hours and grouping; WhatsApp message counts are logged for the company (YX-NTF-13, YX-NTF-12).

title: Notification preferences and quiet hours
story: As an employee, I want to choose my channels and quiet hours so that I am not disturbed at night.
acceptance: Given a type is mandatory, when I open preferences, then I cannot turn it off (YX-NTF-05).
Given my preference, company policy and default differ, when a message is sent, then my preference wins, then company policy, then default (YX-NTF-05).
Given quiet hours 9 pm–8 am in my time zone, when a non-urgent push, WhatsApp or SMS is due, then it waits until 8 am; in-app is not delayed (YX-NTF-06).

title: Scheduler for time-based reminders
story: As an HR admin, I want reminders sent at the right time (check-in, expiry, due dates) so that people act before it is late.
acceptance: Given a scheduled reminder (for example comp-off expiry in 7 days), when the time comes, then the event is raised once through the outbox (YX-NTF-01, YX-NTF-02).
Given the subject is already resolved, when the reminder time comes, then no reminder is sent.
Given the scheduler was down, when it restarts, then missed reminders are sent once, not twice (YX-NTF-02).

title: Reminders and escalation for slow approvals
story: As an HR admin, I want reminders and escalation when an approver is slow so that employees get answers on time.
acceptance: Given a step has an SLA of 2 working days, when time is counted, then only working time on the approver's location calendar counts (YX-WF-09).
Given the SLA is near, when the reminder time comes, then the approver gets a reminder through the notification engine (YX-WF-09).
Given the SLA is broken, when escalation is set, then the task is escalated as configured; auto-approve happens only for types the company enabled (YX-WF-09).

title: Admin delivery log and channel status
story: As a system admin, I want to see failed deliveries and bounced addresses so that I can fix contact details.
acceptance: Given a delivery failed after retries, when I open the delivery log, then I see recipient, channel, status, provider id and error (YX-NTF-10).
Given an email bounced, when it is reported, then the address is marked bad and not used until it changes (YX-NTF-11).
Given I filter by channel and date, when I search, then the log shows only matching attempts.

title: All screen text comes from the message catalogue
story: As an employee, I want the app in Hindi, Tamil or Telugu so that I understand every screen.
acceptance: Given a developer adds hard-coded screen text, when CI runs, then the build fails (YX-NTF-17).
Given an employee screen, when I pick Telugu, then all strings show in Telugu; a missing string falls back to company default, then English (YX-NTF-17).
Given an admin screen, when I pick Hindi, then it may stay in English (admin screens English first) (YX-NTF-17).

title: Slack and Teams notifications and approvals
story: As a manager, I want to see and approve simple requests in Slack or Teams so that I do not switch apps.
acceptance: Given my Slack account is not linked by SSO, when an event happens, then I get no personal data in Slack (YX-NTF-16).
Given a request type is marked chat-safe, when I press approve in Teams, then P03 permissions and self-approval are checked again at the click (YX-NTF-16, YX-WF-04).
Given the type is not chat-safe, when the card shows, then it only has an 'Open in YukthiX' link (YX-NTF-16).

title: Statutory rules stored as dated, versioned data
story: As a payroll admin, I want every legal rate and limit to come from dated rule data so that the system follows the law on each date.
acceptance: Given any statutory rate, slab, ceiling, due date or list, when code needs it, then it reads a published rule set, never a hard-coded value (YX-STAT-01).
Given a rule set is published, when someone tries to edit it, then it is refused; only a new version can supersede or withdraw it (YX-STAT-02).
Given the statutory schema, when the app's tenant role tries to write to it, then the write fails; it is read-only and has no tenant key (YX-STAT-10).

title: Rules evaluated for the period date
story: As a payroll admin, I want calculations to use the rule valid on the period date so that old and new law are never mixed.
acceptance: Given a calculation for a period, when it asks the evaluator, then the rule set valid on that period date is used and its version is stored with the result (YX-STAT-05).
Given a period that ends before 21 Nov 2025, when evaluated, then the old Acts are used; a period straddling that date is split into two segments (YX-STAT-20).
Given the same input and date, when evaluated twice, then the result is the same.

title: YukthiX team publishes a rule change with review
story: As a YukthiX compliance editor, I want to publish rule changes with source, tests and a second review so that wrong rules never reach customers.
acceptance: Given a new rule set version, when I try to publish, then it must cite its legal source with a stored copy (YX-STAT-03).
Given shape validation or a golden test case fails, when I publish, then publishing is blocked (YX-STAT-04).
Given all checks pass, when I publish, then a second person must review and approve it (YX-STAT-04).

title: Company sees its rules and picks legal options
story: As an HR admin, I want to see which rules apply to my entities and choose only the options the law allows so that we stay compliant.
acceptance: Given a statutory rate, when I open the tenant view, then I cannot change it (YX-STAT-06).
Given a legal option (for example PF on actual wage), when I choose it for an entity, then it is saved with an effective date (YX-STAT-06).

Given a new employee of a given employment type, when defaults are applied, then PF, ESI, PT, LWF, bonus and gratuity applicability come from the rule set; an override is allowed only where it is marked a legal option (YX-STAT-13).

title: Admins are told about rule changes
story: As a payroll admin, I want a plain message when a rule changes that affects my company so that I can prepare.
acceptance: Given a rule change is published, when it affects my entities, then I get an in-app and email message with a plain summary and impact count (YX-STAT-08).
Given the effective date is near, when the reminder time comes, then I get a reminder (YX-STAT-08).
Given the banner, when I view it, then it shows only to admins of affected entities, from publication to effective date + 7 days, and I can dismiss it (YX-STAT-12).

title: Load the time and leave rule packs
story: As an HR admin, I want leave, holiday, overtime and working-hour laws loaded so that leave and attendance follow each state's rules.
acceptance: Given IN.LEAVE, IN.OSH and state S&E rule sets, when they are loaded, then maternity values, OT caps, minimum rest, working-hour limits and night windows come from them (YX-STAT-01, YX-STAT-23).
Given each rule set, when it is loaded, then it has golden test cases and a cited source (YX-STAT-03, YX-STAT-04).
Given a location's state, when the attendance engine asks for the OT cap, then it gets the value valid on that date (YX-STAT-05).

title: Private document storage with verification
story: As an HR admin, I want employee documents stored safely and verified so that payroll only uses checked PAN and bank proofs.
acceptance: Given a file, when someone opens it, then access is by a short-lived signed link after a permission check; Confidential / Special downloads are audited (YX-DOC-01).
Given an upload, when the type or size is wrong or the virus scan fails, then it is quarantined and the uploader is told why (YX-DOC-02).
Given storage, when a file is saved, then it is in the tenant's region, under a tenant prefix, encrypted (YX-DOC-03).
Given a PAN or bank proof, when not yet verified, then payroll and filings do not use it; a successful penny-drop or PAN check marks it verified (YX-DOC-17).

title: Document types, versions and expiry
story: As an HR admin, I want each document to have a type that sets its class, expiry and retention so that I do not set them by hand.
acceptance: Given a document type, when a file is uploaded, then class, verification need, expiry and retention come from the type (YX-DOC-04).
Given a re-upload, when saved, then a new version is made and old ones stay for HR until retention ends (YX-DOC-05).
Given an expiry date, when it is near, then reminders go out and the document becomes 'expired' automatically (YX-DOC-06).

title: E-sign and acknowledgement with evidence
story: As an employee, I want to sign or accept a document with OTP so that my consent is recorded.
acceptance: Given I sign, when it completes, then time, IP, device, OTP channel and document hash are stored (YX-DOC-12).
Given signing is complete, when the PDF is sealed, then a completion page is added (YX-DOC-12).
Given a provider certificate is used, when stored, then it is part of the evidence (YX-DOC-12).

title: HR admin sets up leave types
story: As an HR admin, I want to create leave types with eligibility, crediting, counting and year-end rules so that each type works like our policy.
acceptance: Given I edit a leave type, when I change counting (sandwich, holidays, half days), then the live example shows the effect (YX-LV-03).
Given an unpaid (LWP) type, when I save it, then it has no balance settings (YX-LV-14).
Given I set a negative limit, when I save, then the limit is stored per type (YX-LV-04).
Given I set the leave year (calendar, financial or custom), when I save, then accruals and year end use it.

title: Leave policies assigned by rule
story: As an HR admin, I want to bundle leave types into a policy and assign it by entity, location, grade or type so that each employee gets the right leaves.
acceptance: Given a policy rule for 'Chennai, Grade 3', when an employee matches, then the policy applies from that date as a dated fact.
Given I override one employee's policy, when I save, then only that employee changes and the change is dated.
Given the long-absence and notice-period settings per type, when I save, then they are stored for later use (YX-LV-11, YX-LV-12).

title: One leave balance from the ledger
story: As an employee, I want to see the same leave balance on every screen so that I trust it.
acceptance: Given credits, debits, adjustments and expiries, when the balance is shown anywhere, then it is the sum of the ledger entries (YX-LV-01).
Given an LWP type, when I view my balance card, then I see 'taken this year', never a negative balance (YX-LV-14).
Given a paid type, when the balance goes negative, then it stays within the type's limit (YX-LV-04).

title: Leave accrues automatically
story: As an HR admin, I want leave to be credited every month or quarter by the policy so that I do not credit it by hand.
acceptance: Given a monthly accrual with 0.5 rounding, when the job runs, then the credit is rounded per the type; the last accrual of the year trues up to the exact entitlement (YX-LV-02).
Given 'by days worked' or 'LOP-reduced' basis, when the job runs, then it reads attendance after the lock (YX-LV-02).
Given an employee is on sabbatical or long LWP, when accrual runs, then it pauses or continues as the type is set; maternity follows the statutory value (YX-LV-11).
Given a negative balance, when a new accrual is posted, then it first repays the negative (YX-LV-04).

title: Holiday calendars per location
story: As an HR admin, I want a holiday calendar for each location with optional holidays so that each office follows its own festivals.
acceptance: Given a calendar, when I create it, then I can start from the state festival template and clone it to next year.
Given a public holiday falls on a weekly off, when the calendar setting is substitute / comp-off / none, then that is applied (starter: none) (YX-AT-11).
Given an employee transfers, when the transfer date comes, then their calendar switches and optional holidays are prorated or reset per setting (YX-LV-13).
Given optional holidays (choose N of M), when an employee picks more than N, then it is refused.

title: HR adjusts a balance and employee projects it
story: As an HR admin, I want to adjust a balance with a reason, and as an employee I want to see my future balance, so that both of us plan well.
acceptance: Given I adjust a balance, when I save without a reason, then it is refused; with a reason, a ledger entry is added (YX-LV-01).
Given an employee asks 'what is my balance on 1 Dec', when it is computed, then future accruals and booked leave are included (YX-LV-01).
Given migration opening balances, when they are imported, then they are ledger entries with reason 'opening balance' (YX-LV-01).

title: Change the leave year in the middle
story: As an HR admin, I want to change our leave year safely so that balances move to the new year correctly.
acceptance: Given I change the leave year start, when I save, then a short year with pro-rata entitlements is created (YX-LV-13).
Given the short year, when the transition wizard runs, then I see a preview of carry forward per employee before approval (YX-LV-13).
Given I approve, when it finishes, then ledger entries are posted and nothing is posted twice if re-run (YX-LV-01).

title: Leave requests, comp-off and year end
Employee applies for leave
story: As an employee, I want to apply for leave and see how many days it counts and my balance after so that I know before I submit.
acceptance: Given I pick a date range with half days, when the summary shows, then it counts days with the type's sandwich, holiday and weekly-off rules for my location (YX-LV-03).
Given the request breaks notice, max per request/month, block dates or attachment rules, when I try to submit, then the summary shows the warning and blocks where the rule says (YX-LV-05).
Given the request would go below the negative limit, when I submit, then it is refused (YX-LV-04).
Given I submit, when it routes, then the approval engine picks the approver and I can name a delegate while away (YX-WF-01).

title: Manager approves leave with team view
story: As a manager, I want to see who else is off when I approve leave so that the team is covered.
acceptance: Given a request, when I open the approval card, then I see team availability ('2 others off').
Given a medical certificate is attached, when I open the card, then I see only 'certificate attached · verified / pending', never the file (YX-LV-09, YX-DOC-18).
Given HR verifies the certificate, when it is stored, then it is a P05 'Medical certificate' document of Special class (YX-LV-09).
Given I approve, when the decision is final, then the ledger debit is posted once (YX-WF-10).

title: Employee cancels or withdraws leave
story: As an employee, I want to cancel leave I no longer need so that my balance comes back.
acceptance: Given an approved leave before payroll lock, when I cancel and it is approved, then a reversing ledger entry is posted (YX-LV-01).
Given the leave is not yet approved, when I withdraw it, then it is closed without approval.
Given the leave date is in a locked period, when I cancel, then it becomes a late correction with effect in the next payroll (YX-LV-08).

title: Year-end wizard for carry forward, lapse and encash
story: As an HR admin, I want a year-end wizard with a preview so that carry forward and lapse are correct for everyone.
acceptance: Given year end, when I open the wizard, then I see a preview per employee of carry forward, lapse and encashment (YX-LV-07).
Given I approve, when it posts, then ledger entries and draft encashments are created; nothing runs outside the wizard (YX-LV-07).
Given encashment drafts, when they are created, then they go to payroll as one-time pay with the type's formula.

title: Leave during notice period
story: As an employee serving notice, I want to know what happens if I take leave so that I am not surprised.
acceptance: Given I am in notice, when I apply, then the sheet warns per the type policy: allowed, LOP, extends last day or blocked (YX-LV-12).
Given the policy is 'extends last day', when the leave is approved, then the new last working day goes to the exit case (YX-LV-12).
Given the policy is LOP, when approved, then the days go to payroll as LOP (YX-LV-12).

title: Maternity leave from the statutory template
story: As an HR admin, I want maternity leave to follow the law automatically so that eligibility and days are always correct.
acceptance: Given an employee applies, when she has fewer than 80 days worked in the past 12 months, then the request is refused with the reason (YX-LV-10).
Given the case (normal, 3rd child, adoption, miscarriage, tubectomy), when days are counted, then 26 / 12 / 6 / 2 weeks from P07 are used, max 8 weeks before delivery (YX-LV-10).
Given she is ESIC-covered, when the leave is approved, then it is recorded but payroll pays no employer maternity pay (YX-LV-10).
Given maternity leave is active, when someone starts an employer-initiated exit, then it is blocked; accrual continues as the law requires (YX-LV-10, YX-LV-11).

title: Injury leave from an accident case
story: As an HR admin, I want to post injury leave from a workplace accident case so that the injured person is not marked absent.
acceptance: Given an M08 accident case, when I record injury days, then injury leave is posted only from that case, with no balance or accrual (YX-LV-15).
Given injury leave days, when the day engine runs, then they count as service and never as LOP (YX-LV-15).
Given the manager views the days, when they open them, then they see 'injury leave', never the diagnosis (YX-LV-15).
Given the ESIC accident report form and time limit, when the case is opened, then they come from P07 (YX-STAT-25).

title: Mandatory block leave for BFSI
story: As a compliance officer, I want designated people to take their yearly block leave so that we meet regulator guidance.
acceptance: Given the BFSI pack is on, when a designated person has no block planned by the cut-off, then they are listed for the compliance officer (YX-LV-16).
Given the block starts, when it begins, then system access is suspended until return (YX-LV-16).
Given access is needed during the block, when it is given, then a logged compliance-officer exception is required (YX-LV-16).

title: HR admin defines shifts
story: As an HR admin, I want to define shifts with times, breaks, grace and thresholds so that attendance is judged fairly.
acceptance: Given a night shift 10 pm–6 am, when I save it, then it crosses midnight and is attributed to the start date.
Given a split shift, when an employee has two shifts in one day, then each is evaluated separately (YX-AT-13).
Given grace, thresholds, break rule and OT policy, when I save, then they are stored on the shift as a dated fact.

title: Weekly offs and shift patterns
story: As an HR admin, I want weekly offs and rotating shift patterns as rules so that I do not enter each day.
acceptance: Given a 4-on / 2-off pattern from a start date, when a date is checked, then the shift or weekly off is resolved from the pattern.
Given several sources (roster, pattern, group, company), when a date is checked, then the precedence rule decides the weekly off (YX-AT-02).
Given weekly offs, when stored, then they are never saved as holiday rows (YX-AT-02).

title: Manager builds and publishes a roster
story: As a manager, I want to drag shifts onto people and publish the roster so that my team knows when to work.
acceptance: Given I assign shifts, when two shifts overlap or rest between them is below the minimum, then the roster flags it (YX-AT-07).
Given I publish, when it is saved, then affected employees are notified (YX-AT-07).
Given an employee asks to swap with a colleague, when the colleague agrees and the approver approves, then the roster updates (YX-WF-10).
Given I copy last week, when I paste, then leave and holidays are shown as conflicts.

title: Women's night-shift guard
story: As an HR admin, I want the system to stop placing a woman on a night shift without consent and safeguards so that we follow the law.
acceptance: Given a woman has no valid night-work consent for the date, when any path (manual, pattern, swap, open shift, bid, auto-roster) places her in the legal night window, then it is refused with the reason (YX-AT-25).
Given the location's safeguards checklist has lapsed, when the same is tried, then it is refused (YX-AT-25).
Given the company's night definition, when it is saved, then it can be wider but never narrower than the P07 window for the state (YX-AT-25).
Given she withdraws consent, when the next roster is published, then she is not placed at night and no adverse action is allowed.

title: Night-work consents, safeguards and register
story: As a location admin, I want consents, safeguard attestations and the night-shift register kept for me so that I am ready for an inspection.
acceptance: Given a consent, when a woman signs it, then it is stored as a P05 document (YX-AT-26).
Given a safeguard item has a review date, when the date is near, then the location admin and HR are alerted (YX-AT-26).
Given a period, when it is locked, then the register of women night-shift workers is generated in the dated P07 format and frozen (YX-AT-26).

title: Employee checks in on mobile or web
story: As an employee, I want to check in from my phone or browser and see why it fails so that my attendance is correct.
acceptance: Given my location's geofence or IP rule, when I check in, then the punch stores source, location verdict and device, and duplicates are ignored (YX-AT-01).
Given I am outside the geofence, when I try to check in, then I see my pin, accuracy and the allowed area, a plain reason ('Outside Chennai HQ, 850 m away') and a Retry location button (YX-AT-23).
Given my attempt is refused or abandoned, when it ends, then it is logged (YX-AT-23).
Given multiple allowed locations, when I am inside any one, then the punch is accepted.

title: Biometric device and kiosk punches
story: As an HR admin, I want punches from biometric devices and shared kiosks so that factory workers without phones are recorded.
acceptance: Given a device pushes punches, when duplicates arrive, then they are ignored (YX-AT-01).
Given a kiosk punch by employee code + PIN or ID QR, when stored, then it carries the kiosk id and location (YX-AT-01).
Given a punch for a shift that started before the lock, when it arrives, then it attaches to that shift without a late request (YX-AT-13).
Given a CSV upload, when it is imported, then each row is validated and errors are listed by row.

title: Offline check-in on mobile
story: As a field employee, I want to check in without network so that my attendance is saved and synced later.
acceptance: Given no connectivity, when I check in, then the punch is queued on the device with device time, GPS and accuracy and shows 'pending sync' (YX-AT-24).
Given I am back online, when sync runs, then the punch is stored with device time and server time and flagged offline (YX-AT-24).
Given a synced offline punch, when the day engine runs, then it uses the device time (YX-AT-24).

title: Day card shows punch details
story: As a manager, I want to see each punch's source and location on the day card so that I can check doubtful attendance.
acceptance: Given I am in scope, when I open a day card, then I see each punch's source, map pin, distance to the nearest allowed location and verdict (YX-AT-15).
Given I am not in scope, when I try to open it, then it is refused.
Given a field-recorded punch, when shown, then the verdict says 'field-recorded' (YX-AT-15).

title: Day engine, requests, overtime and muster
Attendance mode per group
story: As an HR admin, I want to set each group to Punch, Assumed present or Timesheet mode so that office staff do not need to punch.
acceptance: Given a scoped setting (entity, location, department, employment type), when an employee is checked, then they resolve to exactly one mode (YX-AT-09).
Given Punch mode, when I set the missing-punch effect, then I choose block (default) or warn (YX-AT-09).
Given Assumed-present mode, when days are evaluated, then no missing-punch exceptions are raised (YX-AT-09).
Given the mode, when the muster opens, then the mode and block/warn switch are shown.

title: Day engine works out each day's status
story: As an employee, I want my day status worked out correctly from my punches, leave and holidays so that I am not marked absent by mistake.
acceptance: Given a missing check-out, when the day is evaluated, then the status is 'missing check-out', never a threshold status (YX-AT-03).
Given an employee is suspended, on long leave, pre-boarding or exited, when those days are evaluated, then no exceptions, late marks or nudges are raised (YX-AT-10).
Given a half-day leave, when the day is evaluated, then grace starts at the working half, the leave half has no late penalty, and OT uses half-day hours (YX-AT-12).
Given a late punch sync or an approved regularisation, when inputs change, then the day is re-evaluated until the period is frozen.

title: Comp-off credit and expiry
story: As an employee, I want comp-off credited when I work on a holiday so that I can take a day off later.
acceptance: Given I worked on a holiday or weekly off and it is approved, when the day is evaluated, then a comp-off credit is posted (optional manager approval).
Given the type's expiry window, when the expiry date is near, then I am notified in advance (YX-LV-06).
Given the credit expires unused, when the date passes, then an expiry ledger entry is posted (YX-LV-06).

title: Late penalties by company policy
story: As an HR admin, I want late arrivals counted by our policy so that penalties are fair and visible.
acceptance: Given the late policy (for example 3 lates = half day), when lates are counted, then the tenant's policy is applied (YX-AT-05).
Given a penalty, when it is applied, then it shows on the day card and muster before it affects pay (YX-AT-05).
Given the employee is on leave for the late half, when evaluated, then no penalty is counted (YX-AT-12).

title: Overtime counted and approved
story: As a manager, I want to approve overtime that was really worked so that only correct OT is paid.
acceptance: Given an employee works 7 minutes past shift end, when OT is counted, then nothing counts below the policy minimum (YX-AT-04).
Given OT above the minimum, when counted, then it is rounded down to the policy unit and capped at the P07 limit (YX-AT-04).
Given OT is pending, when payroll reads it, then only approved OT reaches payroll (YX-AT-04).

title: Regularisation, WFH and on-duty requests
story: As an employee, I want to fix a missed punch or mark WFH or on-duty so that my day status is correct.
acceptance: Given I missed a punch, when I raise a regularisation, then it routes for approval and the day is re-evaluated when approved (YX-WF-10).
Given I am within the monthly limit, when I raise it, then it goes to my manager; beyond the limit it routes to HR (YX-AT-06).
Given an approved WFH or on-duty, when the day is evaluated, then the status is WFH / on duty.

title: Today board, muster and team calendar
story: As a manager, I want to see my team's attendance today and for the month so that I know who is in.
acceptance: Given I am a manager, when I open the Today board, muster, team calendar or attendance calendar, then it opens on my team, not just me (YX-AT-14).
Given I am HR, when I open them, then they open on my entity (YX-AT-14).
Given I am an employee, when I want my own view, then I use the mobile Time tab (YX-AT-14).
Given a late penalty, when it is applied, then it shows on the muster (YX-AT-05).

title: Attendance exceptions list with nudges
story: As an HR admin, I want a list of days still missing punches so that we fix them before payroll.
acceptance: Given a Punch-mode employee has a working day without complete punches and no leave, WFH, on-duty, holiday or weekly off, when the day is evaluated, then an exception is raised (YX-LOCK-07).
Given Timesheet mode, when a working day has no approved timesheet, then that is the exception (YX-LOCK-07).
Given Assumed-present mode, when days are evaluated, then no exception is raised (YX-LOCK-07).
Given open exceptions, when the employee and manager are nudged, then the list shows the block/warn effect for payroll (YX-AT-08).

title: Basic timesheets for Timesheet-mode groups
story: As a contract employee, I want to submit my hours as a timesheet so that I am paid for approved hours.
acceptance: Given I am in Timesheet mode, when I submit a week's hours, then they route for approval (YX-AT-09).
Given the timesheet is approved, when the day is evaluated, then the status comes from the approved hours (YX-AT-09).
Given hours are not approved, when payroll reads the feed, then they are never paid (YX-PAY-24).

title: Attendance feed to payroll
story: As a payroll admin, I want payable days, LOP, approved OT and shift allowances from attendance so that I do not type them.
acceptance: Given a period, when payroll asks for the feed, then it gets payable days, LOP days, approved OT hours and shift / night allowance counts per employee (YX-AT-04).
Given Assumed-present groups, when the feed is built, then LOP comes from HR's manual entry, not from punches (YX-AT-09).
Given open exceptions in a block group, when the feed is requested, then the group is marked 'not ready' (YX-AT-08).

title: Finish the Time screens against the real API
story: As the founder, I want the Time screens in packages/yx-ui/src/screens/time wired to the real API so that what we reviewed is what users get.
acceptance: Given each Time story in packages/yx-ui/src/screens/time, when it loads, then data comes from the API, with empty, loading and error states.
Given the review files packages/yx-ui/review/TIME-REVIEW.md and TIME-REVIEW-ROUND2.md, when the screens are finished, then every open item is fixed or listed with a reason.
Given a manager opens the muster, when it loads, then it opens on the team scope (YX-AT-14).
Given a day card, when opened, then it shows punch source, pin and verdict from the API (YX-AT-15).

title: Field-force location trail with consent
story: As a field sales employee, I want location tracked only while I am on duty and with my consent so that my privacy is safe.
acceptance: Given my group has tracking on and my consent is on record, when I check in for duty, then location points are collected until check-out (YX-AT-16).
Given I am on leave, weekly off, holiday or after check-out, when the app runs, then no points are collected unless an approved on-duty covers the day (YX-AT-16).
Given tracking is on, when I look at the app, then it shows 'Tracking on' (YX-AT-16).

title: Client-site visit check-in
story: As a field employee, I want to check in at a client site with a photo so that my visit counts as present.
acceptance: Given I check in at a site, when it is saved, then it records the geofence verdict, a camera-only stamped photo and notes (YX-AT-17).
Given a beat plan, when the manager views it, then planned vs done is shown (YX-AT-17).
Given mock location, impossible speed or gaps, when detected, then they are flagged, never auto-penalised (YX-AT-17).

title: Distance-based conveyance draft
story: As a field employee, I want my travel distance turned into a draft mileage claim so that I claim it easily.
acceptance: Given a duty day's distance, when it is computed, then a draft M05 mileage line is created (YX-AT-18).
Given the draft, when I do not confirm it, then nothing is reimbursed (YX-AT-18).
Given the maps add-on is off, when distance is computed, then straight-line × company factor is used (YX-AT-18).

title: Auto-roster generator
story: As a manager, I want the system to suggest a roster from demand so that I save hours each week.
acceptance: Given hard constraints (skills, hard availability, leave, holidays, minimum rest, hour caps, women's night guard, status), when the generator runs, then none is broken (YX-AT-19, YX-AT-25).
Given company weights, when it optimises, then the result shows the score and the reasons.
Given a draft roster, when I accept it, then it is published like a normal roster (YX-AT-07).

title: Open shifts and shift bidding
story: As an employee, I want to claim open shifts or bid for shifts so that I can get the hours I want.
acceptance: Given an open shift, when it is offered, then only employees who pass skill, location, conflict, rest and hour checks see it (YX-AT-20).
Given I claim it, when it is awarded, then the checks run again (YX-AT-20).
Given bids in a window, when it closes, then awards follow the company's tie-break rule (YX-AT-20).

title: Desktop or Teams presence as punches
story: As a WFH employee, I want my first and last active time from Teams to be my punches so that I do not punch by hand.
acceptance: Given the company turned it on for my group and I consented, when I am active, then only presence states and times are collected (YX-AT-21).
Given presence data, when stored, then no keystrokes, screenshots, app names, URLs or files are ever collected (YX-AT-21).
Given the day, when evaluated, then first-active / last-active punches with source 'teams' or 'desktop' are used (YX-AT-21).

title: Visitor management at reception
story: As a receptionist, I want to check visitors in and out with a badge so that we know who is on site.
acceptance: Given a visitor, when they arrive, then they need pre-registration or a host-approved walk-in (YX-AT-22).
Given the location requires NDA or safety acknowledgement, when they check in, then it is captured before entry (YX-AT-22).
Given a blocked visitor, when they try to check in, then reception is stopped; an 'on site now' list is available for emergencies (YX-AT-22).

title: Strike, lockout and lay-off day statuses
story: As an HR admin, I want to record a strike or lay-off event so that those days are not marked absent.
acceptance: Given a recorded strike, lockout or lay-off, when days are evaluated, then they get that status, not Absent or LOP (YX-AT-27).
Given HR changes the event's legality, when saved before the lock, then affected days are recomputed (YX-AT-27).
Given the event, when created or changed, then it is audited (YX-AT-27).

title: Standby and call-out slots
story: As a manager, I want to roster standby slots and log call-outs so that on-call staff are paid correctly.
acceptance: Given a standby slot, when rostered, then it is not a working shift (YX-AT-28).
Given a call-out during standby, when logged, then it counts for hours, OT and minimum-rest checks (YX-AT-28).
Given standby slots in the period, when payroll reads the feed, then standby allowance per slot is sent (YX-AT-28).

title: Licence gate on rosters
story: As an HR admin, I want people without a valid licence kept off shifts that need one so that we stay safe and legal.
acceptance: Given a shift needs a licence, when the person's licence is missing or expired, then no roster path places them (YX-AT-29).
Given a legally required licence, when someone tries to override, then it is not allowed (YX-AT-29).
Given a company-required licence, when HR overrides with a reason, then it is allowed and audited (YX-AT-29).

title: Hybrid office-day compliance
story: As a manager, I want to see how many office days each person did this week so that we follow the hybrid policy.
acceptance: Given office geofence, kiosk or badge evidence, when the week is computed, then office days are counted against the group policy (YX-AT-30).
Given leave, holidays or approved travel, when computed, then the target is pro-rated (YX-AT-30).
Given the result, when shown, then it never feeds pay, LOP or ratings unless a P19 rule says so (YX-AT-30).

title: Lock service checks every pay-affecting write
story: As a payroll admin, I want frozen and locked periods protected so that paid data never changes by accident.
acceptance: Given a write to attendance, pay-affecting leave, payroll inputs or paid expenses, when it happens, then the lock service is checked in the same transaction (YX-LOCK-01).
Given a period is approved in payroll, when approval succeeds, then payroll, attendance and pay-affecting leave for it lock together (YX-LOCK-04).
Given the stages open → frozen → locked → filed, when a period moves, then each stage is shown on the readiness screen.

title: Late requests on frozen or locked dates
story: As an employee, I want to fix my attendance or leave for last month so that my pay is corrected next month.
acceptance: Given a date in a frozen or locked period, when I raise a request within the company's maximum lateness, then an extra HR approval step is added (YX-LOCK-02, YX-WF-11).
Given the request is approved, when it posts, then it becomes a dated correction with arrears or LOP reversal in the next payroll; the locked period does not change (YX-LOCK-03, YX-LV-08).
Given the request is past the maximum lateness, when I try, then only HR can make a correction (YX-LOCK-02).
Given any request, when it is approved, then it never reopens the period (YX-WF-11).

title: HR device backfill for late biometric batches
story: As an HR admin, I want to apply a late biometric batch in one audited action so that I do not raise a request per employee.
acceptance: Given a batch with punches for frozen or locked dates, when it arrives, then it is held, not applied (YX-AT-13).
Given I run device backfill with a reason, when it is applied, then it is one audited action and effects land in the next payroll (YX-LOCK-09, YX-LOCK-03).
Given a punch for a shift that started before the lock, when it arrives, then it attaches without backfill (YX-AT-13).

title: Tamper-proof audit trail
story: As a system admin, I want every important change recorded in an audit log that nobody can edit so that we can prove what happened.
acceptance: Given a change in an audited category, when it is saved, then the audit row is written in the same transaction (YX-AUD-01).
Given an audit row, when anyone tries UPDATE or DELETE, then the database refuses; actor details are a snapshot (YX-AUD-02).
Given the daily job, when it verifies the hash chain and it fails, then YukthiX security and the tenant's system admins are alerted (YX-AUD-03).

title: Audit log and record timeline viewer
story: As an HR admin, I want to search the audit log for my scope so that I can answer 'who changed this?'.
acceptance: Given a record, when I open its timeline, then I see business events only; field churn is only in the audit log (YX-AUD-05).
Given restricted areas (POSH, disciplinary, medical), when I am not a member, then I cannot see their audit; Confidential / Special values are masked if I lack the field permission (YX-AUD-06).
Given I view a salary several times in 30 minutes, when sensitive-view events are written, then they are deduplicated (YX-AUD-04).
Given I export the audit log, when it downloads, then the export itself is audited (YX-AUD-07).

title: Audit retention and legal hold
story: As a system admin, I want audit kept for 8 years and protected by legal hold so that we meet legal needs.
acceptance: Given retention, when a tenant tries to set below 8 years, then it is refused (YX-AUD-08).
Given rows older than 13 months, when the job runs, then they move to archive; a deletion writes a deletion record (YX-AUD-08).
Given a case under legal hold, when the job runs, then its audit entries are not archived or deleted (YX-AUD-08).

title: Irreversible actions record what the user confirmed
story: As an auditor, I want to see what the user saw when they confirmed an irreversible action so that the record is complete.
acceptance: Given an irreversible action (publish payslips, release bank file, approve run, reopen, bulk change), when the user confirms in the dialog, then the audit event stores the dialog's details (YX-AUD-09).
Given the dialog, when shown, then it says exactly what will happen and how many records.
Given the user cancels, when the dialog closes, then nothing is changed or audited.

title: Documents, letters and e-sign for payroll
Generate payroll letters from templates
story: As an HR admin, I want salary revision and other letters made from templates so that they are correct and consistent.
acceptance: Given a required field is empty, when I generate, then it fails with the list of missing fields (YX-DOC-07).
Given merge fields, when I author or render, then I can only use fields I may see (YX-DOC-08).
Given an issued letter, when saved, then it is immutable with a hash; a correction supersedes it; reference numbers have no gaps per entity and type (YX-DOC-09).
Given an approval-required letter type, when issued, then it goes through P03 first (YX-DOC-10).

title: Letter verification code
story: As a bank officer, I want to verify a salary letter with a QR code so that I know it is real.
acceptance: Given an issued letter, when it renders, then it carries a QR / code unless the company turned it off for that type (YX-DOC-11).
Given the public verify page, when opened, then it shows only company, letter type, name, date and current / superseded (YX-DOC-11).
Given a superseded letter, when verified, then it shows 'superseded' (YX-DOC-11).

title: Alumni and nominee access to pay documents
story: As a former employee, I want to download my payslips and Form 16 after I leave so that I have them for loans and tax.
acceptance: Given I exited, when I log in with OTP, then I can only read my own payslips, Form 16 and issued letters, for 7 years (YX-DOC-16).
Given a death in service, when HR releases documents, then each nominee gets a read-only OTP login limited to those documents, audited (YX-DOC-19).
Given the last working day passes, when I try other screens, then access is refused (YX-DOC-16).

title: Document retention and deletion
story: As a system admin, I want files deleted or anonymised after their retention period so that we keep data only as long as needed.
acceptance: Given a file past its retention, when the job runs, then it is deleted or anonymised and logged (YX-DOC-13).
Given a legal hold, when the job runs, then the file is kept (YX-DOC-13).
Given a medical certificate, when retained, then it stays with the leave record it supports (YX-DOC-18).

title: Payroll setup, templates and India packs
Payroll setup wizard per legal entity
story: As a payroll admin, I want a setup wizard for each entity so that registrations, pay group and bank format are complete before the first run.
acceptance: Given I switch a statute on, when I save, then a completeness check of its required fields runs and blocks file generation until complete (YX-PAY-36).
Given TAN, address and responsible person, when returns are drafted, then they come from statutory registrations and are never retyped (YX-PAY-36).
Given the wizard steps (registrations, pay group and cut-off, template, bank format, accounting, opening balances), when one is incomplete, then the readiness screen shows it.

title: Salary template with safe formulas
story: As a payroll admin, I want to build a CTC salary template with formulas so that pay is calculated the same way for everyone.
acceptance: Given a formula, when it runs, then it uses a sandboxed expression language with no code execution (YX-PAY-01).
Given I save a template, when it has a cycle or wrong order, then save fails; a test run on a sample employee is required (YX-PAY-01).
Given I edit a template, when I save, then a new version is created and past payslips do not change (YX-PAY-01).
Given a component with its own proration formula, when prorated, then that formula is used; otherwise amount × payable days ÷ period days, never twice (YX-PAY-02).

title: Wage flags and the Code wage
story: As a payroll admin, I want components flagged for PF, ESI and Code wages so that statutory bases are right whatever the component is called.
acceptance: Given component flags, when the PF wage is computed, then it uses flags, not names (YX-PAY-17).
Given a payslip from 21 Nov 2025, when exclusions exceed 50 % of total pay, then the excess is added back to Code wages (YX-PAY-47, YX-STAT-21).
Given the add-back wage, when PF, ESI, gratuity and bonus are computed, then they use it as the base (YX-STAT-21).

title: Assign and revise compensation with checks
story: As an HR admin, I want to assign or revise an employee's salary through approval so that every change is checked.
acceptance: Given a revision, when submitted, then it goes through P03 and the revision letter comes from P05 (YX-WF-01).
Given the wage, when it is below max(state minimum for zone and skill, national floor wage), then a warning is shown (YX-PAY-22, YX-STAT-09, YX-STAT-22).
Given a state rate below the floor, when shown, then the tenant view says the floor is applied (YX-STAT-22).
Given pay basis hourly or daily, when saved, then the rate and OT / holiday multipliers are stored (YX-PAY-24).

title: Load India payroll rule packs
story: As a payroll admin, I want PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, bonus and gratuity rules loaded as dated data so that calculations follow the law.
acceptance: Given the packs, when loaded, then IN.PF, IN.ESI, IN.PT, IN.LWF, IN.TDS, IN.BONUS, IN.GRATUITY come with sources and golden cases (YX-STAT-01, YX-STAT-03).
Given PT for a state, when computed for a year, then the ₹2,500 annual cap per employee per employer is enforced (YX-STAT-11).
Given penalties and interest, when needed, then they come from dated penalty parameters (YX-STAT-14).
Given TDS rules, when loaded, then each carries a law version IT-1961 or IT-2025 and non-salary sections are data (YX-STAT-24, YX-STAT-15).

title: Statutory coverage monitor
story: As a payroll admin, I want to be warned when we cross a headcount threshold for PF or ESI so that we register on time.
acceptance: Given a dated coverage rule, when the daily job counts headcount, then approaching and crossed thresholds are listed on the readiness screen (YX-STAT-27).
Given a threshold is crossed, when the next run is approved, then approval is blocked until the statute is on with its registration, or 'applied, number awaited' is recorded (YX-PAY-53).
Given PF once covered, when headcount drops, then coverage stays on (YX-STAT-27).

title: Opening balances and year-to-date import
story: As a payroll admin, I want to import YTD figures for people who joined mid-year so that tax and YTD totals are right.
acceptance: Given imported YTD lines, when YTD is shown, then only payslips of the same employment in that FY up to this period count (YX-PAY-10).
Given Form 12B income, when imported, then it feeds the tax projection (YX-TAX-02).
Given an entity that started mid-year, when the quarterly return is drafted, then prior-month deductee rows come from the import; missing months block with a Fix link (YX-TAX-15).

title: Payslip layout per legal entity
story: As a payroll admin, I want to design the payslip layout per entity so that payslips look right and show what the law needs.
acceptance: Given the layout editor, when I change sections, order or languages, then I see a sample-employee preview (YX-PAY-35).
Given the template, when stored, then it is a P05 .docx template rendered by the single pipeline and activated only after placeholders validate and a preview is viewed (YX-DOC-15).
Given Hindi, Tamil or Telugu, when the PDF renders, then fonts are embedded (YX-DOC-14).
Given a column with no values, when rendered, then it is hidden (YX-PAY-35).

title: Readiness screen and pre-run validation
story: As a payroll admin, I want to see what blocks the run before I calculate so that I fix problems first.
acceptance: Given the run, when validation runs, then it checks bank details, PAN (warning only), UAN / ESI numbers, compensation, attendance and more (YX-PAY-05).
Given each group, when the readiness screen opens, then it shows the attendance mode and block / warn (YX-AT-09).
Given a wage below the minimum, when validation runs, then it warns (YX-PAY-22).
Given a coverage threshold crossed, when validation runs, then it is listed (YX-PAY-53).

title: Payroll inputs: attendance, LOP and one-time pay
story: As a payroll admin, I want attendance, LOP and one-time pay in one place so that the run has all inputs.
acceptance: Given Punch or Timesheet groups, when inputs load, then payable days, LOP and approved OT come from the attendance feed (YX-AT-04).
Given Assumed-present groups, when inputs load, then HR enters LOP / payable days by hand (YX-AT-09).
Given LOP, when prorated, then the company's day basis (calendar, 30 or 26) is used (YX-PAY-02).
Given the cut-off, when processing starts, then inputs are frozen (YX-PAY-07).

title: Calculate the run with per-employee progress
story: As a payroll admin, I want to calculate payroll and see each employee's result so that I can fix failures fast.
acceptance: Given calculation, when it runs, then I see per-employee progress and a failure names the employee, record and field with a Fix link (YX-PAY-34).
Given a salary change mid-month, when calculated, then the payslip is split into segments and each line shows its segment (YX-PAY-03).
Given an employee already has a regular payslip for the period and pay group, when another run includes them, then it is rejected (YX-PAY-04).
Given each line, when saved, then it stores its formula, inputs and rule version for the 'why this number' drawer (YX-PAY-12, YX-STAT-05).

title: PF, EPS and EDLI on every payslip
story: As a payroll admin, I want PF calculated correctly for every case so that ECR is right.
acceptance: Given PF-eligible employees, when calculated, then employer EPF, EPS, EDLI and admin charges are on every payslip and in CTC (YX-PAY-17).
Given age 58, pre-2014 members or international workers, when calculated, then the special EPS rules apply (YX-PAY-17, YX-PAY-33).
Given the EPS higher-pension flag, when calculated, then EPS uses actual wage (YX-PAY-33).

title: ESI coverage and contributions
story: As a payroll admin, I want ESI applied by the contribution-period rules so that coverage is right.
acceptance: Given an employee is covered at the start of the contribution period, when pay rises above the ceiling, then coverage continues until the period ends (YX-PAY-18).
Given ESI amounts, when calculated, then they round up to the next rupee and the daily-wage exemption applies (YX-PAY-18).
Given consented disability status, when coverage is tested, then the PwD ceiling from P07 is used; a change applies from the next contribution period (YX-PAY-56, YX-STAT-30).

title: Professional tax and LWF by work state
story: As a payroll admin, I want PT and LWF deducted for the right state so that no one pays twice.
acceptance: Given the work-location state on the deduction date, when calculated, then state slabs, frequency and deduction month come from P07 (YX-PAY-19).
Given a state change in the period, when calculated, then exactly one liable state per slot is used and shown on the payslip (YX-PAY-54, YX-STAT-28).
Given the annual PT cap of ₹2,500, when the year's total would exceed it, then the deduction is reduced (YX-STAT-11, YX-PAY-19).

title: Variance review before approval
story: As a payroll admin, I want to see big changes from last month so that mistakes are caught before pay goes out.
acceptance: Given each payslip, when compared to last period, then changes above ±10 % net or any new / removed component are flagged (YX-PAY-06).
Given flagged lines, when I submit for approval, then each must be acknowledged first (YX-PAY-06).
Given I change the threshold in settings, when the next run compares, then the new threshold is used.

title: Approve the run and lock the period
story: As a finance approver, I want to approve the payroll run as a second person so that pay is checked before release.
acceptance: Given the run, when submitted, then it follows the run's approval chain with maker ≠ checker (YX-PAY-07, YX-WF-05).
Given Punch groups with block on and open exceptions, when approval is tried, then it is blocked; with warn, they are listed as warnings (YX-LOCK-08, YX-AT-08).
Given approval, when it succeeds, then the period locks with attendance and pay-affecting leave (YX-LOCK-04).
Given approval, when done, then bank file, payslip publication and journal become available (YX-PAY-07).

title: Reopen a locked payroll
story: As a payroll admin, I want to reopen a locked payroll in rare cases with approval so that a serious mistake can be fixed.
acceptance: Given I request reopen, when I submit, then a reason, Payroll Admin and System Admin / owner approval are needed (YX-LOCK-05).
Given the bank file is released, payslips are published or a return is filed, when I request reopen, then it is refused (YX-LOCK-05).
Given the reopen is approved and I recalculate, when payslips change, then new versions are made and old ones are kept and marked revised (YX-LOCK-06).

title: Cancel a calculated run
story: As a payroll admin, I want to cancel a wrong run without losing its history so that audits stay clean.
acceptance: Given a calculated run, when I cancel it, then it is marked void, never deleted (YX-PAY-08).
Given a void run, when viewed, then its payslips show as void (YX-PAY-08).
Given the cancel, when done, then it is audited (YX-PAY-08).

title: Salary holds and release
story: As a payroll admin, I want to hold an employee's pay with a reason and release it later so that we handle absconding or missing documents.
acceptance: Given a hold, when created, then it has a reason code; triggers (absconding, failed payment, exit clearance) create holds automatically (YX-PAY-28).
Given a held payslip, when the bank file is made, then it is left out (YX-PAY-28).
Given I release it, when done, then only that run's payslip is released and repeating the action changes nothing (YX-PAY-09).

title: Recoveries, negative net and court orders
story: As a payroll admin, I want loan EMIs, advances and court orders deducted in the right order so that pay never goes negative.
acceptance: Given recoveries, when net would fall below the protected minimum, then the recovery is deferred (YX-PAY-11).
Given net still negative, when calculated, then net is set to zero and the shortfall carries forward to next runs and F&F (YX-PAY-29).
Given a court attachment, when calculated, then it applies after statutory deductions and before loans, by order date, within the total deduction cap (YX-PAY-32).

title: Subsistence allowance during suspension
story: As a payroll admin, I want suspended employees paid subsistence allowance so that we follow standing orders.
acceptance: Given an employee suspended pending inquiry, when the run calculates, then a subsistence-allowance component at the P07 rate replaces normal pay (YX-PAY-23).
Given the suspension ends mid-period, when calculated, then the period is split (YX-PAY-03).
Given the state's standing orders, when the rate changes by days of suspension, then the P07 rate for those days is used (YX-PAY-23).

title: Maternity benefit and injury pay
story: As a payroll admin, I want maternity and injury days paid by the law and company policy so that no one is underpaid.
acceptance: Given maternity leave, when calculated, then benefit = average daily wage of the last 3 months × days, plus medical bonus if no care given (YX-PAY-26).
Given an ESIC-covered employee, when calculated, then no employer maternity pay is made (YX-PAY-26, YX-LV-10).
Given injury leave days, when calculated, then ESI-covered get only a company top-up if set; others get at least the P07 compensation (YX-PAY-50, YX-LV-15).

title: Statutory bonus and gratuity provision
story: As a payroll admin, I want bonus and gratuity calculated by the law so that year-end payouts are right.
acceptance: Given the Payment of Bonus rules, when bonus is computed, then eligibility wage, ceiling and 8.33–20 % come from P07 (YX-PAY-16).
Given each month, when calculated, then gratuity is provisioned as wage × 15/26 × years, capped (YX-PAY-15).
Given a fixed-term employee, when eligibility is checked, then pro-rata after 1 year applies (YX-PAY-15).

title: Hourly and daily rate pay from timesheets
story: As a payroll admin, I want contract workers paid from approved hours so that pay matches work.
acceptance: Given rate-based pay, when calculated, then pay = approved hours (or days) × rate × category multiplier (YX-PAY-24).
Given unapproved hours, when calculated, then they are never paid (YX-PAY-24).
Given OT and holiday multipliers from the rate card, when applied, then each line shows the multiplier (YX-PAY-12).

title: Journal export and employee cost rates
story: As a finance user, I want a journal export and monthly cost rates so that accounts and project costing are right.
acceptance: Given an approved run, when I export the journal, then it follows the entity's accounting mapping (YX-PAY-07).
Given a paid month, when cost rates are computed, then cost = employer cost ÷ standard hours from the approved payslip; open months are marked provisional (YX-PAY-42).
Given cost rates, when someone without payroll / finance scope asks, then they are hidden (YX-PAY-42).

title: Generate the bank file
story: As a payroll admin, I want a bank file for the approved run so that salaries are paid on time.
acceptance: Given an approved run, when the bank file is made, then account numbers and IFSC stay as text with leading zeros (YX-PAY-13).
Given the file, when built, then it includes only approved, unwithheld, verified-account payslips (YX-PAY-13).
Given a file already made, when regenerated, then a reason is required (YX-PAY-13).
Given I release it, when I confirm in the irreversible-action dialog, then the confirmation is audited (YX-AUD-09).

title: Record payment status and handle failures
story: As a payroll admin, I want to mark payments paid, failed or returned so that failed salaries get paid again.
acceptance: Given bank results, when recorded, then each payslip has paid / failed / returned status (YX-PAY-14).
Given a return, when recorded, then the employee is notified in the app (+ SMS with no amounts) to fix bank details (YX-PAY-14).
Given corrected bank details, when checker approves and penny-drop passes, then the cooling period is skipped (YX-PAY-14).
Given a failed payment, when the next bank file or off-cycle is made, then it is included (YX-PAY-14).

title: Cash and cheque disbursement register
story: As a payroll admin, I want to pay some workers by cash or cheque with proof so that it is still controlled.
acceptance: Given the company enabled cash / cheque, when I set it for an employee, then a reason and approval are needed and it is audited (YX-PAY-31).
Given such payslips, when the bank file is made, then they go to the disbursement register instead (YX-PAY-31).
Given payment, when recorded, then a signature or acknowledgement upload is required (YX-PAY-31).

title: Publish payslips and view them
story: As an employee, I want to see my payslip in the app with an explanation of each number so that I understand my pay.
acceptance: Given an approved run, when HR publishes, then employees get the payslip in the app and a notification (YX-PAY-07).
Given a payslip line, when I tap 'why this number', then I see the formula, inputs and rule version (YX-PAY-12).
Given the PDF, when rendered, then it uses the entity's payslip layout (YX-PAY-35).
Given I download it, when the link is made, then it is a short-lived signed link (YX-DOC-01).

title: Payslip PDF by email (company option)
story: As an employee, I want my payslip emailed as a protected PDF so that I have a copy in my mail.
acceptance: Given the entity's payslip email policy is off (default), when payslips publish, then no PDF is emailed (YX-NTF-15).
Given it is on, when sent, then the PDF is AES-256 password protected, the email states the scheme but not the password, and shows no amount (YX-NTF-15, YX-NTF-04).
Given an unverified email address, when sending, then nothing is sent (YX-NTF-15).

title: Employee raises a query on a payslip
story: As an employee, I want to ask a question about my payslip in the app so that I get an answer without email.
acceptance: Given a payslip or a line, when I raise a query, then it lands in the Payroll Admin query queue (YX-PAY-25).
Given a reply, when sent, then it stays in the app (YX-PAY-25).
Given each query action, when taken, then it is audited (YX-PAY-25).

title: Employee picks a tax regime
story: As an employee, I want to compare the old and new regime and choose one so that I pay less tax.
acceptance: Given no choice, when tax is computed, then the new regime is used (YX-TAX-01).
Given the cut-off has passed, when I try to change, then only HR can change it with a reason (YX-TAX-01).
Given my choice, when tax is computed, then the slab set matches the regime (YX-TAX-01).

title: Monthly TDS projection and tax sheet
story: As an employee, I want to see how my monthly TDS is worked out so that I trust the deduction.
acceptance: Given a run, when TDS is computed, then TDS = (projected annual tax − tax already deducted) ÷ remaining periods, including Form 12B and other income (YX-TAX-02).
Given an employee, when components are set, then only one tax component is allowed (YX-TAX-02).
Given my tax sheet, when shown, then it equals the tax deducted, from the same function (YX-TAX-06).
Given YTD, when shown, then only same-employment payslips in the FY up to now count (YX-PAY-10).

title: Declarations and proof verification
story: As an employee, I want to declare investments and upload proofs so that my tax is reduced.
acceptance: Given proofs are not yet verified, when TDS is projected, then declarations are used (YX-TAX-03).
Given the proof cut-off has passed, when projected, then only verified amounts count and extra tax is spread over the remaining periods (YX-TAX-03).
Given each line, when verified, then payroll or HR approves, rejects or partly approves with a comment; I cannot approve my own (YX-TAX-05).

title: HRA exemption month by month
story: As an employee paying rent, I want HRA exemption worked out correctly so that I get my tax benefit.
acceptance: Given rent for some months, when computed, then exemption is calculated per month over months of actual employment and rent (YX-TAX-04).
Given rent above the P07 threshold, when declared, then landlord PAN is required (YX-TAX-04).
Given the result, when shown in the tax sheet, then each month's value is listed.

title: Missing PAN and residential status
story: As a payroll admin, I want TDS handled when PAN is missing or the employee is non-resident so that we deduct the right amount.
acceptance: Given PAN missing or inoperative, when the run happens, then it is not blocked and TDS = higher of 20 % or slab rate, flagged PANNOTAVBL (YX-TAX-10).
Given each run and filing, when it starts, then PAN operative status is checked via P10 (YX-TAX-10).
Given a non-resident, when tax is computed, then no 87A rebate; treaty rate only with a valid TRC (YX-TAX-11).

title: Perquisites, leave encashment and VRS tax
story: As a payroll admin, I want perquisites and exit payouts taxed correctly so that Form 12BA and TDS are right.
acceptance: Given a company car or accommodation, when valued, then the P07 rules apply and they show in Form 12BA (YX-TAX-12).
Given leave encashment on exit, when taxed, then the exemption is the least of the four limbs, within the ₹25 L lifetime cap less prior use; in service it is fully taxable (YX-TAX-09).
Given VRS compensation, when taxed, then the exemption up to the P07 limit applies once per lifetime (YX-TAX-21).

title: Tax continuity across transfers and rehires
story: As a payroll admin, I want tax to continue when an employee moves entity or rejoins in the same year so that TDS is not wrong.
acceptance: Given an inter-entity transfer, when it happens, then Form 12B is auto-filled in the new entity and declarations are copied (YX-TAX-13).
Given a rehire in the same FY, when TDS is computed, then YTD, TDS and Form 130 combine per PAN × TAN × FY (YX-TAX-13, YX-PAY-10).
Given gratuity paid twice, when exemption is computed, then one lifetime limit is used (YX-TAX-13).

title: Income-tax law version on every computation
story: As a payroll admin, I want old and new Income-tax Act forms used for the right periods so that filings are accepted.
acceptance: Given a period up to 31 Mar 2026, when TDS, returns or certificates are made, then IT-1961 forms (24Q, Form 16) are used (YX-TAX-19, YX-STAT-24).
Given a later period, when made, then IT-2025 forms (Form 138, Form 130) are used (YX-TAX-19).
Given any computation, when saved, then it records its law version (YX-TAX-19).

title: Year-end Form 130 for employees
story: As an employee, I want my Form 130 (Form 16) in the app so that I can file my return.
acceptance: Given year end, when Form 130 is made, then it uses tax actually deducted and includes leavers (YX-TAX-07).
Given Part B, when generated, then it is signed with the company DSC and published to employees and alumni (YX-DOC-16).
Given a correction return is accepted, when the corrected Part A is ready, then a revised Form 130 / 131 is generated (YX-TAX-20).

title: Statutory hub and compliance calendar
story: As a payroll admin, I want one hub showing every statutory task with due dates so that nothing is filed late.
acceptance: Given each statute and month, when I open the hub, then I see status, file, acknowledgement, due date and P07 penalty estimate if late (YX-STAT-14).
Given a file, when downloaded, then only payroll scope can download and each download is audited (YX-PAY-21).
Given a due date is near, when the scheduler runs, then the owner is reminded.

title: PF ECR and ESI return files
story: As a payroll admin, I want PF ECR and ESI files made from the locked run so that I upload them to the portals.
acceptance: Given a locked period, when files are made, then they read statutory values stored on the payslip, not current settings (YX-PAY-20).
Given a period already generated, when regenerated before filing, then a reason is needed; after filing it is refused (YX-PAY-21).
Given ELI-eligible employees, when the ECR is built, then it carries the scheme fields and expected vs received incentive is tracked (YX-PAY-55, YX-STAT-29).

title: PT and LWF returns
story: As a payroll admin, I want PT and LWF returns per state so that state filings are correct.
acceptance: Given a period, when returns are made, then they are per entity and state and show the state used per employee (YX-PAY-54).
Given values, when read, then they come from the payslip (YX-PAY-20).
Given one deduction per period per employment, when the return is built, then no employee appears twice (YX-PAY-19).

title: TDS challan pre-filled with interest
story: As a payroll admin, I want the TDS challan pre-filled from approved runs so that I deposit the right amount.
acceptance: Given a deposit month, when the challan opens, then TDS per section and entity TAN come from approved runs (YX-TAX-14).
Given late deduction or deposit, when computed, then interest and late fee come from P07 parameters (YX-TAX-14, YX-STAT-14).
Given I edit the challan, when I save, then a reason is required and audited (YX-TAX-14).

title: Quarterly TDS return (Form 138 / 24Q)
story: As a payroll admin, I want the quarterly TDS return drafted and validated so that I file it on time.
acceptance: Given the quarter, when the return is drafted, then it uses tax actually deducted and the challan window by deposit date (YX-TAX-07).
Given an entity that started mid-year, when drafted, then prior-month rows come from imported YTD; missing months block with a Fix link (YX-TAX-15).
Given deductor details, when filled, then they come from statutory registrations (YX-PAY-36).
Given a filed return, when anyone tries to change it, then it is locked; corrections need a correction return (YX-TAX-08).

title: Correction returns and revised certificates
story: As a payroll admin, I want to file a correction return when we find a mistake so that employees get correct certificates.
acceptance: Given a filed return, when I correct it, then a correction return linked to the original is created (YX-TAX-08).
Given the correction is accepted, when the corrected Part A is available, then revised Form 130 / 131 are generated and published (YX-TAX-20).
Given old periods, when corrected, then 24Q / Form 16 are used (YX-TAX-19).

title: PF and ESI corrections after filing
story: As a payroll admin, I want to correct a filed PF or ESI month the legal way so that the portal data is right.
acceptance: Given a filed ECR month, when a correction is needed, then a supplementary / arrear ECR is produced, never a regenerated original (YX-PAY-51).
Given a filed ESI month, when corrected, then a past-period contribution is produced (YX-PAY-51, YX-STAT-26).
Given excess remittance, when found, then the P07 treatment (adjustment or refund) is shown (YX-STAT-26).

title: Always-on digital registers
story: As a location admin, I want statutory registers made automatically each month so that I am ready for inspection.
acceptance: Given a period locks, when registers are generated, then every register P07 requires for each location is made in the format valid on that date (YX-PAY-39, YX-STAT-16).
Given registers, when generated, then they read payslip values and are frozen and DSC-signed (YX-PAY-20, YX-PAY-39).
Given the compliance calendar, when the month ends, then a register sign-off item appears (YX-PAY-39).

title: Labour-law advisory feed
story: As a compliance owner, I want short advisories about new labour laws in my states so that I can act early.
acceptance: Given an advisory, when published, then it cites its source and passed maker ≠ checker review (YX-STAT-17).
Given my entities' states, when an advisory is published, then only the compliance owner, HR and payroll admins of those tenants see it (YX-STAT-17).
Given urgent advisories, when published, then they are notified at once; others go in a weekly digest (YX-STAT-17).

title: Off-cycle runs, arrears and full and final
Off-cycle runs for bonus and corrections
story: As a payroll admin, I want off-cycle runs for bonus or corrections so that I do not wait for the monthly run.
acceptance: Given an off-cycle run, when created, then it uses the same engine and approval as the regular run (YX-PAY-07).
Given an off-cycle run, when created, then it does not count as the regular payslip for the period (YX-PAY-04).
Given it is approved, when paid, then it has its own bank file (YX-PAY-13).

title: Arrears engine for back-dated changes
