story: As a payroll admin, I want back-dated salary changes paid as arrears month by month so that PF and tax are right.
acceptance: Given a back-dated revision, when arrears run, then each month's difference = corrected − as-paid (YX-PAY-52).
Given months before go-live, when computed, then as-paid comes from the imported as-paid lines (YX-PAY-52).
Given PF / ESI / PT on arrears, when computed, then the P07 basis rules apply and PF/ESI are attributed to the month they relate to where the rule says so (YX-PAY-33).

title: Past-dated rule change creates an arrears proposal
story: As a payroll admin, I want to be told when a rule is changed backwards in time so that I can pay or recover the difference.
acceptance: Given a past-dated publication, when it is published, then processed payrolls it affects are flagged per tenant (YX-STAT-07).
Given flagged payrolls, when I open them, then an arrears / recovery proposal is shown; nothing is silently recalculated (YX-STAT-07).
Given I accept the proposal, when the next run calculates, then the arrears lines appear (YX-PAY-33).

title: Full and final run within 2 working days
story: As a payroll admin, I want the F&F run created on the approved last working day so that we pay leavers within 2 working days.
acceptance: Given an approved LWD for any exit type, when it comes, then the F&F off-cycle run is created with a 2-working-day deadline from the entity's calendar (YX-PAY-48).
Given a negative leave balance, when F&F runs, then it is deducted at the encashment rate or converted to LWP per type (YX-LV-04).
Given notice-period leave effects, when F&F runs, then the shortfall days are included (YX-LV-12).
Given gratuity eligibility, when F&F runs, then gratuity is paid by the law (5 years; fixed-term pro-rata after 1 year) (YX-PAY-15).

title: Retrenchment lines in F&F
story: As a payroll admin, I want retrenchment compensation added to F&F automatically so that we follow the IR Code.
acceptance: Given a retrenchment exit, when F&F runs, then compensation = 15 days' average pay × completed years (YX-PAY-49, YX-STAT-23).
Given notice was not given, when F&F runs, then notice pay in lieu is added (YX-PAY-49).
Given a retrenchment, when F&F runs, then the Worker Re-skilling Fund line is added and a remittance calendar item is created (YX-PAY-49, YX-STAT-23).

title: F&F on death in service
story: As an HR admin, I want F&F paid to nominees by their share so that the family gets money quickly and correctly.
acceptance: Given nominations, when F&F runs, then each nominee is paid their share % to a verified bank account (YX-PAY-27).
Given no valid nomination, when HR verifies heirs' documents, then legal heirs are paid (YX-PAY-27).
Given death, when gratuity is computed, then the 5-year condition is waived and heir TDS follows P07 (YX-TAX-12).
Given nominees, when HR releases documents, then they get the nominee login (YX-DOC-19).

title: Overpayment recovery plan
story: As a payroll admin, I want to recover an overpayment in instalments with the employee's consent so that it is fair and legal.
acceptance: Given an overpayment, when a plan is made, then the employee's consent is recorded as a P05 acknowledgement (YX-PAY-30, YX-DOC-12).
Given a recovery across the FY, when reported, then it is in the correct year with 89(1) / Form 10E data (YX-PAY-30).
Given a write-off, when done, then approval with a reason is needed and it is audited (YX-PAY-30).

title: Consultant register
story: As an HR admin, I want to add consultants with PAN, bank and TDS section so that we pay them correctly.
acceptance: Given a consultant, when paid, then PAN (or recorded absence), a verified bank account and a default TDS section must be recorded (YX-PAY-37).
Given a GSTIN, when entered, then it is validated (YX-PAY-37).
Given a consultant, when payroll runs, then they get no payslip, PF, ESI, PT or LWF (YX-PAY-37).

title: Consultant invoices and approval
story: As a consultant, I want to upload my monthly invoice so that I am paid without emails.
acceptance: Given an invoice, when I upload it, then a duplicate number in the same FY is rejected (YX-PAY-38).
Given an invoice, when submitted, then it is approved through P03 with maker ≠ checker (YX-PAY-38, YX-WF-05).
Given approved invoices, when the bank file is made, then they are paid in it (YX-PAY-38).

title: TDS on consultant invoices
story: As a payroll admin, I want TDS on each invoice by section and threshold so that we deduct the right amount.
acceptance: Given an invoice, when TDS is computed, then the section (194C, 194J(a), 194J(b)), rate by deductee type and thresholds come from P07 (YX-TAX-16, YX-STAT-15).
Given a s.197 certificate, when valid and within limit, then its rate applies (YX-STAT-15).
Given no PAN, when computed, then the 206AA rate applies (YX-TAX-16).

title: Form 140 and Form 131 for consultants
story: As a payroll admin, I want the consultant TDS return and certificates made for me so that I file on time.
acceptance: Given consultant TDS, when deposited, then it uses the same challan per section as salary TDS (YX-TAX-17).
Given the quarter, when Form 140 is drafted, then it comes from paid invoices and is reconciled deposit vs deduction (YX-TAX-17).
Given filing is done, when Part A is available, then Form 131 is generated for each consultant (YX-TAX-17).

title: Special pay types and country packs
Earned wage access draw
story: As an employee, I want to get part of my earned pay early so that I handle an emergency.
acceptance: Given EWA is on for my group and I am eligible, when I open Get paid early, then I see the available amount = policy % × earned-to-date, fee and recovery date (YX-PAY-40).
Given blackout days, when I try to draw, then it is refused (YX-PAY-40).
Given a draw, when the next regular payroll runs, then it is recovered in full within the deduction cap (YX-PAY-41).

title: Weekly and fortnightly pay groups
story: As a payroll admin, I want weekly or fortnightly runs for some groups so that daily-wage workers are paid often.
acceptance: Given a weekly pay group, when the period comes, then it gets its own run, readiness, payslip and bank file (YX-PAY-58).
Given PF / ESI, when computed per run, then they are aggregated into the monthly return (YX-PAY-58).
Given TDS, when computed, then it is projected on annualised run pay (YX-PAY-58).

title: Piece-rate pay with minimum-wage top-up
story: As a payroll admin, I want piece-rate workers paid by output with a minimum-wage guarantee so that pay is legal.
acceptance: Given output and the rate card, when calculated, then earnings = Σ(output × rate valid on the output date) (YX-PAY-59).
Given earnings below the time-rate minimum for days worked, when calculated, then a named top-up line is added (YX-PAY-59, YX-STAT-31).
Given OT for piece-rated workers, when calculated, then the P07 basis is used (YX-STAT-31).

title: Incentive and commission plans
story: As a sales manager, I want incentive plans with tiers and caps so that my team is paid for results.
acceptance: Given a plan from a starter template, when set up, then metric source, quota, tiers, accelerators, cap and clawback window are defined (YX-PAY-60).
Given results, when approved via P03, then they enter the run as one-time pay (YX-PAY-60).
Given a clawback, when triggered, then it is recovered through payroll recoveries (YX-PAY-60).

title: Tips and service-charge pooling
story: As an outlet manager, I want tips pooled and shared fairly so that staff get their share through payroll.
acceptance: Given a pool per outlet per period, when distributed, then it is by points, per shift or by hours from attendance (YX-PAY-61).
Given amounts paid through payroll, when calculated, then they are a named line with PF / ESI / TDS from P07 (YX-PAY-61, YX-STAT-31).
Given tips paid directly by customers, when recorded, then they appear on statements only (YX-PAY-61).

title: On-call, standby and call-out pay
story: As a payroll admin, I want standby and call-out paid from roster data so that on-call staff are paid fairly.
acceptance: Given standby slots, when the run calculates, then a standby allowance per slot is paid (YX-PAY-62, YX-AT-28).
Given a call-out, when calculated, then pay = max(actual hours, call-out minimum) × rate × multiplier (YX-PAY-62).
Given minimum wage and OT floors, when checked, then P07 values apply (YX-PAY-62).

title: Union dues, settlements and lay-off pay
story: As a payroll admin, I want union dues, wage settlements and lay-off pay handled by the IR rules so that we follow the law.
acceptance: Given check-off dues, when deducted, then a recorded authorisation is required, within the cap, remitted per union with a statement (YX-PAY-63, YX-STAT-32).
Given a wage settlement by category and date, when applied, then the arrears engine computes the differences (YX-PAY-63).
Given lay-off days, when calculated, then lay-off compensation per P07 is paid; strike / lockout days follow legality and policy (YX-AT-27, YX-STAT-32).

title: Actuarial census for gratuity and leave
story: As a finance user, I want an actuarial census file per entity so that the actuary can value our liabilities.
acceptance: Given a valuation date, when I generate the census, then it has the standard fields (dates, service, Code wage, leave balances, exits with payouts) (YX-PAY-57).
Given an actuary's layout, when chosen, then the extra columns are added (YX-PAY-57).
Given the actuary's result, when uploaded, then the provision is recorded for journals (YX-PAY-57).

title: ESOP grants, vesting and exercise
